name: Sampled-values relay subscription
summary: Identifies the protection input subscription associated with a named sampled-values stream.
description: Identifies the protection input subscription associated with a named sampled-values stream. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Assigned sampled-values stream” at the input and “Relay measurement input” at the output. Subscription does not establish measurement validity.
